framework.definition: Per team-game: sum over unavailable starters of (position weight × starter-to-backup quality gap), computed per unit (OFF/DEF/ST). Position weights and quality gaps are design parameters — proposed, not sourced facts.
framework.inputs: Official injury report (DNP/Out); official roster ACT/RES status; depth-order source (missing — IR-023)

framework.definition: Share of the unit's projected playing time handled by 2nd/3rd/4th-string players this week. Requires per-player participation data — official weekly snap/participation source to be selected (open question Q9).
framework.inputs: Rosters; injury report; participation data source TBD

framework.definition: Flag a unit when ≥K weighted key absences stack in the same unit (e.g., two DTs + an EDGE in one week). K is a design parameter — proposed.
